info.title: Loams managed engines API
info.summary: Namespace-scoped lifecycle, SQL and Spark sessions/jobs for managed RisingWave, Flink SQL and Spark (preview).
info.description: Design: docs/design/81-managed-stream-batch-engines.md (D2010-D2019). Served by crates/loams-engines (`loams_engines::http::router`) on the native REST listener under /v1. Every engine is preview. Lifecycle calls answer 202 with the instance in its transitional phase; poll GET for the outcome. An instance belongs to one Loams namespace (ENG81 R2). Reads need `can_read` on `environment:<ns>`, lifecycle, SQL, sessions and jobs `can_write`, create, PATCH and delete `can_admin` (D2016, R18: the same relations as `engine#can_view|can_operate|can_admin`). Timestamps are RFC 3339 in UTC. Lists are wrapped in an object keyed by the plural resource name.

Error.description: A stable code and a human message, as the console contract.

SizeTier.description: Per replica: xs 0.5 vCPU / 1 GiB, s 1 / 4 GiB, m 2 / 8 GiB, l 4 / 16 GiB, xl 8 / 32 GiB (D2011).

url.description: The loams-gateway address; engines are never exposed directly.

org.description: The org that owns the namespace; the billing subject is org_<org> (design 63).

version.description: The requested version; status.version is the running one.

state_prefix.description: Where state and checkpoints live in Loams object storage.

InstanceUpdate.description: Exactly one of size (scale) or version (upgrade).

enabled.description: An adapter serves this kind on this install (its profile is on).

estimated.description: The reserved size, not a measurement

state_bytes.description: The latest sample's state bytes (a gauge).

notice.description: For a statement that starts a streaming job (Flink INSERT), the job it started.

detail.description: The adapter's full run status (attempts, driver, timings); only on GET …/jobs/{job}.

entrypoint.description: SQL text, or an object-storage path to a .py file or .jar.

SparkJobSubmit.description: The fields the facade checks; any other field is the engine's own job spec (SP-b's SparkJobSpec) and is passed to the adapter unchanged.

id.description: Chosen by the caller, so a retry is idempotent.

cron.description: UTC; five fields, or six with seconds.

session.name: loams_session
session.description: Console sessions; mutating requests also send X-CSRF-Token.

bearer.description: An access token or an lk_ API key.
